---
title: "Number of loci in mappings to the reference"
author: "J. Ignacio Lucas Lledó"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

It is not easy to determine how many *different* loci are found in mappings
to the reference genome. We need the output of `samtools depth` to see what
loci got any coverage. It was produced once in `2025-07-03/COV`, but
erased because it take too much space.

```{bash}
if [ ! -e ref.cov.txt ]; then
   if [ ! -e ref.cov.tmp ]; then
      ls -1 ../2023-05-18/BAM/*.bam | \
      xargs samtools depth -q 30 -Q 20 -o ref.cov.tmp
   fi
   gawk '{
      TOTALDEPTH = 0
      for (i = 3; i <= NF; i++) {
         TOTALDEPTH += $i
      }
      if (TOTALDEPTH > 0) print $1 "\t" $2 "\t" TOTALDEPTH
   }' ref.cov.tmp > ref.cov.txt
fi
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
library(ggplot2)
dep <- read.table('ref.cov.txt', col.names = c('contig', 'pos', 'depth'))
firstcontigs <- head(unique(dep$contig), 16)
f <- dep$contig %in% firstcontigs
ggplot(data = dep[f,], mapping = aes(x = pos, y = depth)) +
   geom_line() + facet_wrap(~ contig, scale = 'free_x') + ylim(0, 5000)
```

There is a background mapping noise, probably due to off-target sequenced
fragments (mapping quality is not bad). Depth peaks reach scary hights,
which could mean collapsed repeatitive regions or just amplification bias
of some loci. The discontinuity in total depth would not be appreciated in
a plot of the empirical cumulative density function. There is not any obvious
choice of total depth threshold. Let's try a few values and count how many loci,
and how long they are, when considering continuous stretches of a contig with
a certain minimum threshold.

```{r}
mincov <- c(10, 30, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 400, 500, 750, 1000)
MaxDist <- 10
Loci <- lapply(
   mincov,
   function(x) {
      D <- dep[dep$depth >= x, ]
      n <- nrow(D)
      lastcontig <- c('none', D[1:(n-1), 'contig'])
      D$sep <- c(NA, D[2:n, 'pos'] - D[1:(n-1), 'pos'])
      D[D$contig != lastcontig, 'sep'] <- NA
      D$locus <- cumsum(is.na(D$sep) | D$sep > MaxDist)
      N <- length(unique(D$locus))
      L <- mean(table(D$locus))
      SD <- sd(table(D$locus))
      return(data.frame(MinCov = x, Num = N, Size = L, SD = SD))
   }
)
loci <- do.call(rbind, Loci)
ggplot(data = loci, mapping = aes(x = MinCov, y = Num)) + geom_line()
ggplot(data = loci, mapping = aes(x = MinCov, y = Size)) + geom_line()

library('kableExtra')
kable(loci) %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```
